text:
Alisa: Quick FYI — running the new Node sampleapp with otel-hooks shows missing request_id on some log chunks. Repro steps below, appears when logs > 16k and get chunked. Suspect redaction hook runs on chunk boundaries and drops x-request-id. Anyone seen this?

Miguel: huh. can you paste a snippet of the raw log? :eyes:

Alisa: raw (simplified):
```json
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:01:00Z","level":"info","msg":"start","x-request-id":"req_abc123"}
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:01:00Z","level":"info","msg":"payload chunk1..."}
{"time":"2026-03-18T12:01:01Z","level":"info","msg":"payload chunk2...","x-request-id":"req_abc123"}
```
Note: middle chunk lost request id.

Samir: I think the otel log hook attaches metadata per record, but our chunker splits before hook runs in the Node SDK. If redaction runs after chunking it may drop headers. Suggest moving request-id injection earlier (before chunker) or make chunker preserve `x-request-id`.

Miguel: agree. on Node the `logEmitter` runs in stream transform; open to a patch that restores `x-request-id` from context for each chunk. Also redaction should be idempotent — repeated redaction shouldn't remove the header key entirely, just scrub PII.

CI-Bot: Build #4521 failed: devex/sampleapp-node -> tests/log-redaction.test.js:45 assert(reqId) false

Jordan: I can take this. Quick plan: 1) add unit that simulates chunked log with otel hook, 2) ensure `injectRequestId(record)` called inside chunk loop, 3) add regression for redaction that preserves header keys but blanks values. Will target `node-sdk@1.8.x`.

Alisa: thanks! repro script below (runs in Docker):
```bash
node samples/node-chunk-repro.js --size 20000 --otlp=http://localhost:4318
```
sampleapp writes 18k payloads.

Samir: also check for sync vs async redaction. If redaction is async and chunker emits before promise resolves, header disappears. maybe make redaction sync for headers.

Miguel: FYI I created branch `devex/fix-log-chunking-reqid` and added failing test. PR incoming in a bit. /assign @Jordan

Jordan: cool, I'll review. If green, can we cherry-pick to release branch and include note in changelog: 'Fix missing request_id in chunked logs (node SDK) + redaction stability'

Alisa: :thumbsup: also add a quick example in the onboarding docs mentioning how to run the repro and check `x-request-id`.
